{
  "findings": [
    {
      "title": "Primary endpoint PFS definition inconsistent with estimand censoring",
      "quote": "Subjects who do not progress or die will be censored at their last evaluable disease assessment date.",
      "page": 38,
      "section": "2.1.2",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "critical",
      "explanation": "The primary endpoint definition states censoring at last evaluable assessment, but the estimand specifies censoring at last evaluable assessment before or on start of new anti-cancer therapy. This inconsistency could lead to different analysis populations and results.",
      "fix": "Align the PFS endpoint definition with the estimand by specifying censoring at last evaluable assessment before or on start of new anti-cancer therapy."
    },
    {
      "title": "PRO estimand lacks analysis details for multiple endpoints",
      "quote": "Change from baseline to Week 12 in PRO endpoints between AMG 510 and docetaxel",
      "page": 48,
      "section": "3",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The PRO estimand is defined for 'PRO endpoints' collectively, but there are multiple PRO endpoints (dyspnea, cough, chest pain, physical functioning, global health status). No analysis method is specified for handling these multiple endpoints (e.g., mixed models, multiple testing).",
      "fix": "Specify the statistical analysis for each PRO endpoint and how multiplicity across them is addressed."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing estimand attributes for DOR, TTR, DCR",
      "quote": "Duration of response - defined as time from first evidence of PR or CR to disease progression or death due to any cause, whichever occurs first.",
      "page": 48,
      "section": "3",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The secondary endpoints DOR, TTR, and DCR are listed but no estimand attributes (population, intercurrent events, summary measure) are provided for them, unlike the primary and key secondary endpoints.",
      "fix": "Add estimand attributes for DOR, TTR, and DCR, including handling of intercurrent events and summary measures."
    },
    {
      "title": "No analysis stated for safety endpoint",
      "quote": "To compare the safety and tolerability of AMG 510 versus docetaxel",
      "page": 48,
      "section": "3",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The safety objective is listed but no corresponding endpoint or analysis is described in the endpoints table. Safety analysis methods (e.g., incidence of adverse events) are not specified.",
      "fix": "Add a safety endpoint and specify the statistical analysis for safety data."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing analysis for PK endpoint",
      "quote": "To characterize the pharmacokinetics (PK) of AMG 510 and its major metabolites",
      "page": 48,
      "section": "3",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The PK objective is listed but no endpoint or analysis is described. PK parameters and their statistical analysis are not specified.",
      "fix": "Define PK endpoints (e.g., AUC, Cmax) and the analysis methods."
    },
    {
      "title": "Sample size inputs not provided",
      "quote": "The primary endpoint of Study 20190009 is progression-free Survival (PFS).",
      "page": 38,
      "section": "2.1.2",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "critical",
      "explanation": "The protocol does not include a sample size section with inputs such as assumed hazard ratio, event rates, alpha, power, or dropout rates. Without these, the sample size cannot be justified or reproduced.",
      "fix": "Add a sample size section detailing all assumptions and calculations."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing handling of missing data for PFS and OS",
      "quote": "Subjects who do not progress or die will be censored at their last evaluable disease assessment date.",
      "page": 38,
      "section": "2.1.2",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The protocol does not describe how missing data (e.g., missed assessments, loss to follow-up) are handled for PFS and OS beyond censoring. Sensitivity analyses for missing data are not mentioned.",
      "fix": "Specify the primary analysis method (e.g., Kaplan-Meier, Cox) and sensitivity analyses for missing data."
    },
    {
      "title": "Multiplicity not addressed for secondary endpoints",
      "quote": "The key secondary endpoints are OS, objective response rate (ORR), patient-reported outcomes (PRO), including change from baseline (cycle 1 day 1) over time to week 12 in disease related symptoms (dyspnea, cough, and chest pain), physical functioning, and health related quality of life (QOL).",
      "page": 38,
      "section": "2.1.3",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The protocol lists multiple key secondary endpoints but does not describe a hierarchical testing procedure or other multiplicity control method to control the family-wise error rate.",
      "fix": "Define a hierarchical testing order or other multiplicity adjustment for key secondary endpoints."
    }
  ]
}
